We have, of course, three members of last year's winning team still available, and backed up by Wood, Chamberlain, Quackenbos, Merryman and Pointer, they can scarcely fail to do well.

Second points were scored on our behalf by Abberton (Mile), Quackenbos (High Jump), Murdoch (880 yards), Sutton (Shot), and single points for third places came from Johns (220 yards and 100 yards), Lucas (Mile), Blyther (High Jump), Taylor (880 yards), F.
Our remaining points came from Lee (440 yards), and Quackenbos and Grassau (High Jump). Absentees handicapped our team, and a few points in the sprint events would have helped our score along.
Quackenbos is the new Javelin holder. Melchior and Powell were unable to throw, owing to the claims of work, but Quack's win is the reward of persistence.
Quackenbos (holder) cleared 5ft. 2in. for 3rd place. The absence of Les Cohen and Pat Parker robbed the Mile of some of its interest, but an exciting race between W.

Tom Carter shows a gradual return to form, whilst the running of Herbert and Quackenbos, both of whom have done very little training, was very creditable and points to them being very useful team members in the New Year.

Quackenbos (" Quack ") sends his best wishes to the Club and all members from the U.S.A. Although thousands of miles further away from Belgrave Hall than most members, he still finds time to write home.
